fields.acceptance: A testscript stops a fake run at a wait step with --no-wait, then a second rhiza run start on the change set exits 2 naming that run and rhiza run resume, and after the first run finishes a new start succeeds; a Go test starts two runs on one change set concurrently and exactly one begins.
fields.statement: A change set has at most one live run: rhiza run start refuses a change set whose run's journal has not finished (done or failed), an interrupted run included, exiting 2 with the run's ID and a next step of rhiza run resume, and it checks and opens the new journal under one lock so two concurrent starts never both begin.

fields.acceptance: A testscript abandons an interrupted fake run: run status shows it failed with the abandoned detail and the actor, the worktree and branch still exist, rhiza run start on the change set then succeeds, rhiza run resume on the abandoned run exits 2 naming it, and abandoning a finished run exits 2; describe-golden is regenerated.
fields.statement: rhiza run abandon <run> journals an unfinished run as failed with the detail 'abandoned by <actor>', leaving its worktree and branch alone, so a new run can start on the change set; it refuses a finished run, and rhiza run resume refuses an abandoned run, naming it.
